title: wombat.WAV
author: samarobryn
changes: Real recording of a wild common wombat (Vombatus ursinus) munching grass: a steady run of crunchy bites, recorded at the Bundanon Estate, New South Wales (no free recording of a wombat hiss or grunt was found). Trimmed to 67.30–70.25 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 120 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. The 120 Hz high-pass removes measured low-frequency background rumble and hum below the chewing sounds.
